channel.title: Apache SkyWalking – OpenTelemetry
channel.description: Recent opentelemetry posts from Apache SkyWalking

item.title: Getting the Topology Right with OpenTelemetry Traces: Gateways, Queues and Databases
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan
item.description: SkyWalking draws its topology from OTLP spans alone. Gateways, message brokers and databases reached at several addresses are where that gets hard. This post runs each case on a laptop, shows the topology before and after, and the one change that fixes it.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Traces in SkyWalking: Native Storage, Metrics and Topology
item.dc:creator: Kai Wan
item.description: SkyWalking now stores OTLP traces as they arrive and turns them into service metrics, topology and database, cache and MQ dashboards through the new Trace Analysis Language. This quick start runs the OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop against SkyWalking with one command, and shows what to set in your own applications.

item.title: SkyWalking 中的 OpenTelemetry 链路：原生存储、指标与拓扑
item.dc:creator: 万凯
item.description: SkyWalking 现在可以原生存储 OTLP 链路，并通过新的链路分析语言生成服务指标、调用拓扑，以及数据库、缓存和消息队列仪表盘。本文用一条命令将 OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop 接入 SkyWalking，并介绍如何配置自己的应用。
